AgentEvent.description: One Server-Sent Event `data:` payload from /agents/generate or /agents/chat.
AgentEvent.title: AgentEvent

AskCitation.description:
A source chip. `label` and `href` are built by the server from the id (never by the
model): `href` is a path on this site, or an https page on uchicago.edu for `guide`.
AskCitation.title: AskCitation

AskContext.description: Where the student asks from (the companion sends it; the Ask page usually does not).
AskContext.title: AskContext

AskCourse.description: A course the answer mentions; it exists in the catalog.
AskCourse.title: AskCourse

AskStepEvent.description: The agent called a tool ("Searching the catalog for “quantum”").
AskStepEvent.title: AskStepEvent

Atom.description:
`course`: met by a course completed, credited or planned in a strictly earlier term (or
the same term when it is a Summer quarter). `concurrent`: same or earlier term.
`placement`/`standing`: plan facts.
`program`: enrolment restriction (glob on program ids, e.g. `cmsc-*`).
`consent`: never blocks; always produces a warning.
Atom.title: Atom

BoundedPartsNode.description: Parts with [min, max] counts that sum to a total.
BoundedPartsNode.title: BoundedPartsNode

ChangeSetApply.description:
Apply only if the plan still hashes to `base_plan_hash`. `confirmation_text` is the
student's typed confirmation, parsed deterministically and matched against the ops.
ChangeSetApply.title: ChangeSetApply

ChatHistory.description: A saved plan's advisor conversation of the last 30 days, oldest first.
ChatHistory.title: ChatHistory

CommentItem.description: A student's voice about a course: a Commons reply, or (logged in only) a forum post.
CommentItem.title: CommentItem

CommonsBusyEvent.description: Another reader's request is already writing this answer: poll the thread.
CommonsBusyEvent.title: CommonsBusyEvent

CommonsCitation.description:
A source the bot relied on. The web links `course` to /courses/<id>, `program` to
/programs/<id>, `thread` to /forum/t/<id>; `guide` carries the official `url`.
CommonsCitation.title: CommonsCitation

CommonsModerationItem.description: A reported Commons question or reply in the admin's queue.
CommonsModerationItem.title: CommonsModerationItem

CommonsThreadUpdate.description: Only the fields sent change. `course_code: null` detaches the course.
CommonsThreadUpdate.title: CommonsThreadUpdate

ConfirmEvent.description:
The student's message was a typed confirmation of `change_set`. A saved plan applies
it with POST /plans/{id}/changesets/{cs}/apply and `confirmation_text`; a plan that lives
in the browser applies the operations itself.
ConfirmEvent.title: ConfirmEvent

Conflict.description: One goal or limit in the smallest set that makes a request impossible.
Conflict.title: Conflict

CourseForumOut.description:
Course-level view: every instructor's page of one course, pooled (SPEC "Course-level
view: the course page aggregates all its instructors").
CourseForumOut.title: CourseForumOut

CourseList.description:
A named list per catalog year. Members = `courses` plus every course of `sublists`.
A list of sequences (e.g. `core-huma-sequences`) has one sublist per sequence.
CourseList.title: CourseList

CourseStats.description: From `attribute_value` (forum reviews and estimates), when there are any.
CourseStats.title: CourseStats

DashboardStepEvent.description: The agent is calling a tool (`label` is plain English, written by the server).
DashboardStepEvent.title: DashboardStepEvent

Expr.description:
Canonical form: `{op, n, children, atom}`. Shorthand accepted on input:
`"CMSC 14100"`, `{course: X, min_grade: G}`, `{concurrent: X}`, `{placement: X}`,
`{standing: X}`, `{program: X}`, `{consent: X}`, `{all: [...]}`, `{any: [...]}`,
`{n_of: k, of: [...]}`.
Expr.title: Expr

GenerateLocal.description: Generate for a plan that lives only in the browser (logged out, or not saved yet).
GenerateLocal.title: GenerateLocal

GenerateOptions.description:
The Generate-plan form as the deterministic generator reads it (SPEC "Generate-plan
popup"). Locked and completed courses are always kept.
GenerateOptions.title: GenerateOptions

GenerateRequest.description: The Generate-plan popup: a form, never free text (SPEC "Generate-plan popup").
GenerateRequest.title: GenerateRequest

GeneratedVariant.description: One generated plan: a proposed change set plus the verified plan it leads to.
GeneratedVariant.title: GeneratedVariant

GroupNode.description: Children combined: all of them (`all: true`) or at least `n_of`.
GroupNode.title: GroupNode

Illustration.description: Inputs of the page's generated SVG art (no image is fetched).
Illustration.title: Illustration

InfeasibleEvent.description: No plan meets the request; `message` says why in plain English.
InfeasibleEvent.title: InfeasibleEvent

InterviewMemory.description:
What the dashboard agent remembers between visits: the questions it covered (answered
or skipped) and the last turns.
InterviewMemory.title: InterviewMemory

InterviewRequest.description:
`start` opens (or resumes) the interview, `reply` answers the guide's last question,
`welcome_back` greets a returning student.
InterviewRequest.title: InterviewRequest

InterviewTurnEvent.description:
The dashboard agent's next message (Issue #16). `topic` is the id of the question it
asks (data/profile/questions.yaml) or "wrapup". `quick_replies` are that question's option
labels, unchanged, then "Skip". `proposed` holds only the answer the student gave to the
previous question, mapped to its field (list fields already merged with the record); the
browser saves it with PATCH /me/profile once the student accepts it.
InterviewTurnEvent.title: InterviewTurnEvent

MaxFrom.description:
At most `n` of the node's courses may match `selector` ("at most 2 from outside CMSC").

With `as_enrolled`, a course counts only when the code the student enrolled under matches
the selector's subject, number range and tags: a course cross-listed as CMSC 23500 /
CMSC 33550 and taken as CMSC 33550 is not "from the 20000 level".
MaxFrom.title: MaxFrom

NodeProgress.description: Per-node progress for the planner's requirement rail.
NodeProgress.title: NodeProgress

Part.description: One part of a bounded_parts node, e.g. `{id: huma, from: {list: ...}, count: [2, 3]}`.
Part.title: Part

PlanImport.description: Logged-out plans from localStorage, imported at login.
PlanImport.title: PlanImport

PlanItem.description: A course (or an unfilled requirement slot, `slot_ref` = node path) in a term.
PlanItem.title: PlanItem

PostCreate.description: A review requires structured ratings and the term taken; a discussion post has neither.
PostCreate.title: PostCreate

ProfileOut.description: The student record (Issue #14) as the dashboard shows it. `null` = not answered.
ProfileOut.title: ProfileOut

ProfilePatch.description:
A partial update: only the fields sent are changed (`null` clears a field). `credits`
and `taken_courses` replace the whole list. The registration form, the dashboard, the
dashboard agent's accepted answers, the feed and the Commons follow button send these.
ProfilePatch.title: ProfilePatch

QuestionItem.description: A Commons question that is waiting for an answer, or a recent one.
QuestionItem.title: QuestionItem

RatingSummary.description:
Averages over the visible reviews of a forum page (or of every page of a course).
Shown to logged-in readers only.
RatingSummary.title: RatingSummary

RecordCredit.description: An AP, placement or transfer credit (planner_core `Credit`).
RecordCredit.title: RecordCredit

ReviewNode.description: One node of a proposed rule tree, with the quote it came from (prompt 09).
ReviewNode.title: ReviewNode

RouteDraftEvent.description: One drafted route (not saved: POST /me/routes keeps it).
RouteDraftEvent.title: RouteDraftEvent

RouteFit.description: How well the route fits what the student said, 0..1 (an estimate, not a grade).
RouteFit.title: RouteFit

RoutePatch.description:
`status: chosen` makes any other chosen route `open`; `open` on the chosen route keeps
the options open.
RoutePatch.title: RoutePatch

SelectNode.description: Choose `count` courses (or `units` units) from a selector.
SelectNode.title: SelectNode

Selector.description:
Which catalog courses a node may draw from.

A course matches when it is not in `exclude` (by cross-list group) and every criterion that
is set holds: `codes` (any listed code, by cross-list group), `subject`, `number_range`
(inclusive, on the 5-digit number), `tags` (has any), `list` (member of the named
`course_list`, sublists included), `union` (matches at least one sub-selector).

A course's tag set is `tags` plus `"core:" + t` for each of its `core_tags`, so
`tags: ["core:arts"]` matches a course whose `core_tags` contains `arts`.
Selector.title: Selector

ShareLimit.description:
At most `max` courses shared with programs matching `with` (`type:minor`, `core`,
`program:<id>`), not counting nodes/parts named in `except` (e.g. `language`).
ShareLimit.title: ShareLimit

Source.description: Where a rule came from. `quote` is copied verbatim from the page.
Source.title: Source

SuspensionOut.description:
An active suspension, shown by the removal that started it (admins never see who the
author is). One row per suspended author: the latest removal that suspended them.
SuspensionOut.title: SuspensionOut

TakenCourse.description:
A UChicago course the student took or is taking. `grading`, `units` and `locked` are the
plan item's (planner_core `PlanItem`): a rule that needs a letter grade does not count a
Pass/Fail course, so every editor sends them back unchanged.
TakenCourse.title: TakenCourse

TermAway.description: A quarter the student plans to spend away.
TermAway.title: TermAway

UpdateItem.description:
One new thing on Quarterly that concerns the student. Text is plain (no markdown) and
scrubbed of emails and phone numbers; `href` is a path on this site.
UpdateItem.title: UpdateItem

UpdatesSeen.description:
High-water marks: the newest id the student has seen of each kind of item. In a request
a missing mark means "the newest there is now"; marks never move backwards.
UpdatesSeen.title: UpdatesSeen

WeatherOut.description: WMO weather code and cloud cover (percent) now in Hyde Park.
WeatherOut.title: WeatherOut
